entities.name: Probable endonuclease lcl3
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt B6H1W0 from Penicillium rubens; reference annotation calls it probable endonuclease lcl3.
Reference annotation localizes the protein to mitochondrion and membrane, with single-pass membrane topology.
Sequence analysis detects the SNase domain (PF00565.24) at residues 133–250; this supports a nuclease-family relationship but does not determine substrate or activity.
